title: Olive
body:
Description

The Olivewood is a tree type that is found on Finlay. It's located down the grass ramp to the left of Flora Laura's. Once cut down, you can sell the log for $3 per stud. If you use the saw or a sander, you will create the sanded version of the wood which sells for $28,79 per stud. You can also use a planker to get the Planked version, which sells for $36 per stud.

Like any other material in the game, you can use logs, sanded, and planked Olive to complete schematics.


Good for Beginners.
